submitter_description: Account that submits TTL bump transactions. Must have balance for submission fees (~0.001 XLM per bump). Do not log or check in the secret key.
ttl_threshold_description: Extend instance TTL when remaining ledgers fall below this. Default 50,000 ledgers (~69 hours at 5s/ledger).
ttl_extend_description: Extend instance TTL by this many ledgers on each bump. Default 100,000 ledgers (~139 hours at 5s/ledger).
cadence_description: How often to check and potentially bump TTLs (seconds). Default 300 (5 min) for testnet. Use 1800 (30 min) for mainnet to reduce transaction load.

contracts.name: production_escrow
contracts.description: Campaign escrow — fund-critical, highest priority. Custody of all investor principal and farmer tranches.

contracts.name: governance
contracts.description: Governance timelock — required for all parameter changes and contract upgrades. Must remain operational.

contracts.name: registry
contracts.description: Farmer/buyer registry — operational, enables registration and campaign listing.

contracts.name: investment_basket
contracts.description: Batched investment pools — operational, processes investor deposits and distributions.

contracts.name: escrow
contracts.description: Marketplace escrow — operational for marketplace orders, kept separate from campaign escrow.
